meta.description: Your practice profile and what families can share with you on EatPal.

page.title: Professional settings
page.subtitle: Your practice profile, and exactly what families can share with you.
page.loadErrorBody: Nothing has been changed. Check your connection and try again.

guard.deniedTitle: Professional settings come with the Professional plan
guard.deniedBody: The Professional plan is for feeding therapists, dietitians and other clinicians who work with families on EatPal. It gives you a practice profile for the reports families send you, and a plain statement of what you can and can't see of a family's account.
guard.deniedNote: Your current plan doesn't include it. You can compare plans from Billing.
guard.errorBody: We couldn't confirm which plan you're on, so these settings stay closed for now.

clientAccess.title: Client access
clientAccess.description: What families can share with you, and what stays with them.
clientAccess.journalBody: Plain text the parent copies from their Food Journal and sends you by message or email: the days they pick, what was offered at each meal, how much was eaten, and the notes they chose to keep in.
clientAccess.ladderBody: A PDF the parent downloads from the food ladder: where each food sits on the ladder, the attempts over the dates they choose, and what was refused. The child appears by first name only.
clientAccess.sentByParent: The parent decides what to send and when. Nothing reaches you automatically.
clientAccess.neverLead: Each person in a family is told these stay with their own account. Nothing here changes that:
clientAccess.neverShared: Nothing on this page opens a family's account, meal plan, grocery list or pantry.
clientAccess.clientsEmpty: No families have shared access with you yet. Families send reports to you from their Food Journal.

profile.title: Practice profile
profile.description: Shown on reports you receive and invites you send.
profile.logoUrlHint: A link to an image you host, starting with https://
profile.colorsHint: Used on your practice profile. They also tint your own EatPal screens while you're signed in.
profile.saveFailedFallback: Nothing was saved. Please try again.
profile.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save.

errors.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.color: Use a six-digit hex color like #2F6ABC.
errors.https: Enter a full link starting with https://
errors.phone: Use digits, spaces, +, - or brackets, at least 7 characters.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.notLive: Custom domains aren't available yet; this domain isn't live.
domain.body: You added {{domain}} earlier. Nothing serves EatPal from it, and you don't need to change any DNS records. You can remove it.
domain.confirmBody: This only deletes the saved domain name from your account. Nothing else changes.
